limits: one recorded candidate set replayed under two threshold sets; it cannot say how a fresh selector call behaves under zero floors
gate-refused is a subset of assessed, never a disjoint bucket
the fixtures and answer keys are synthetic, author-authored and unadjudicated: this is a sensitivity result, not accuracy
no production threshold, fixture or answer key is changed; the ablation passes its own floors
replay_validation: production floors reproduced the recorded additional/emphasized/omitted IDs and metrics for all 11 encounters, and the replayed assessed set matches the recorded coverage count (the floors are applied after a response, so they cannot gate assessment)
